</text>

<tspan x="717.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="717.0" y="1470" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="717.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

semantic.label: P @ L @ U; unsqueeze
semantic.expression: self.w_p @ (self.w_l * self.l_mask + self.l_eye) @ (self.w_u * self.u_mask + torch.diag(self.s_sign * torch.exp(self.w_s)))
